faq.headline: Everything you need to know before you start.

items.q: Does Dealup use the official WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: Yes, Dealup runs on the official WhatsApp Business API infrastructure.

items.q: Can I try Dealup for free?
items.a: Yes, you can start for free and explore the platform before choosing a plan.

items.q: Are WhatsApp fees included in the subscription?
items.a: No, Meta/WhatsApp messaging fees are billed separately from your Dealup subscription.

items.q: Does Dealup work for cash-on-delivery (COD) orders?
items.a: Yes, Dealup is used by Moroccan e-commerce businesses to confirm and track COD orders.

items.q: How many agents can I add?
items.a: The number of agents depends on your plan. Contact us for a recommendation suited to your team.
Yes, the platform and support are available in French, Arabic, and English.
